text:
sqlpipe transfers data from a Postgres database to Amazon S3 in Parquet format. Three main components form the pipeline: a reader process, a converter component, and an uploader component. These components process data in continuous batches to keep memory usage low and predictable.

The reader process connects to the Postgres database. It streams rows from the database in batches of fixed size. The converter component receives these batches of rows from the reader. It turns each batch of rows into a Parquet row group in memory.

The uploader component receives the Parquet row groups from the converter. It writes the data to Amazon S3 as a multipart object. If a network error occurs during an upload, the uploader retries the operation. This design keeps memory usage low and transfers large tables without data loss.
